whatsappMessage:

I noticed your restaurant has phenomenal 4.7★ reviews with over 1,100 happy customers on Exhibition Road, but your current website link is inactive.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct table booking, multi-cuisine menu, aur online food ordering integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://angrezidhaba.live/

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Angrezi Dhaba team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Angrezi Dhaba) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with instant table booking, interactive menu, and your strong 4.7-star rating showcase right on Exhibition Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
